dct_description_sm: "Sykes-Picot Agreement", officially known as the Asia Minor Agreement was negotiated between November 1915 and March 1916. This treaty had effectively divided the Arab provinces of the Ottoman Empire outside the Arabian Peninsula into areas of future British and French Mandates. The treaty was concluded on 16 May 1916.
Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
Contributors: Great Britain. Foreign Office. Research Department
Shows in colors: International sphere, French sphere, British sphere, Italian sphere, Russian sphere, international frontiers, and boundary of Mandated Palestine.
Shows the partition in three zones, (A) : Independent Arab State in the French sphere -- (B) Independent Arab state in the British sphere -- (C) Italian sphere influence.
